target: King-Tollu-Toumazet (2004) positivity conjecture: a triple (lam,mu,nu), |lam|+|mu|=|nu|, whose stretched Littlewood-Richardson polynomial P(n) = c(n*nu; n*lam, n*mu) has a strictly negative coefficient
cell: r = 4  (hive polytope Q(lam,mu,nu) lives in R^3 = the Reeve dimension; deg P = dim Q <= 3)
scope_of_exhaustiveness: ALL triples (lam,mu,nu) of partitions with at most 4 parts each and |lam|+|mu|=|nu|=W, for every W in {33,...,38}, modulo the exact symmetry c(nu;lam,mu)=c(nu;mu,lam) (which preserves P, hence every quantity tracked here). Triples whose nu has 5 or more parts are outside the r=4 cell by definition and are not part of this band.
band_size_independently_recomputed: yes -- Python recount of (#unordered (lam,mu) pairs) x (#nu) per W reproduces 194911126 exactly

result.min_a1_convention: minimum of the linear coefficient a_1 of the trimmed P over all triples whose polytope has dim >= 1 (so that P actually has a linear term). Attained at dim 1, e.g. lam=11,1 mu=20,1 nu=30,2,1 where P = 1 + n.
result.min_a1_over_dim3_note: 11/6 is exactly the value forced by h* = (1,0,0,0) (unimodular tetrahedron, P = 1 + 11n/6 + n^2 + n^3/6); no 3-dimensional r=4 hive polytope in the band does better.
result.min_a1_over_all_including_dim0: 0 (trivially, from the 12344666 zero-dimensional polytopes where P == 1, and the 169727587 empty ones where P == 0)

reeve_relevant_findings: Negativity criterion used: for a 3-dimensional lattice polytope, 6*a_1 = 11 + 2 h*_1 - h*_2 + 2 h*_3, so a_1 < 0 iff h*_2 > 11 + 2 h*_1 + 2 h*_3. Over the whole band min(6*a_1) on dim 3 is 11, i.e. max(h*_2 - 2 h*_1 - 2 h*_3) = 0: the Reeve excess never becomes positive anywhere in the band, let alone exceeds 11.

All 533432 three-dimensional hive polytopes in the band with exactly 4 lattice points (h*_1 = 0) have normalized volume EXACTLY 1, i.e. every one of them is a unimodular tetrahedron. Not a single empty lattice 3-simplex T(p,q) with q >= 2 occurs -- so the Reeve tetrahedron route (which needs an empty simplex of normalized volume q >= 13) is empirically absent from this band, consistent with the run's theory verdict that q <= 4 is forced and only q = 1 occurs.

All 2039692 three-dimensional hive polytopes in the band were vertex-enumerated exactly; every vertex is a LATTICE point (maximum vertex denominator = 1), so every Q here is a lattice polytope and its Ehrhart counting function is a genuine polynomial.

Largest normalized volume in the band is only 77, attained at c = 32 lattice points -- volume and lattice-point count stay locked together (V < 3c is never violated in the h*_1=0 stratum), which is precisely the opposite of the Reeve regime V >> c.

engine.primary: r4_reeve/census_band5.cpp -> census_band5.exe (exact long-long integer arithmetic only; NO floating point anywhere in the counting path)
engine.method: The 18 rhombus rows are built by build_rows_xyz, copied verbatim from the already validated vcheck.cpp/typescan.cpp. L(n) = #(nQ cap Z^3) is obtained by direct enumeration with exact integer interval propagation. P is recovered from exact finite differences of L(0..3) (legitimate: deg P = dim Q <= 3 and P is a genuine polynomial), and is RE-VERIFIED against independently enumerated L(4) and L(5) for every 3-dimensional polytope.
engine.prefilter: lam <= nu and mu <= nu componentwise (a THEOREM: c^nu_{lam mu} = 0 otherwise; combined with Knutson-Tao saturation this means Q is empty, so P == 0 and no coefficient exists). Verified to change nothing: a control run with the prefilter DISABLED over W in [4,22] reproduces the identical dim histogram and identical extremal witnesses.

honesty_statement: This is an exhaustive NEGATIVE census. It establishes that no counterexample to the King-Tollu-Toumazet conjecture exists among r <= 4 triples of weight 33 <= W <= 38. Absence of a counterexample in this window proves nothing about the conjecture and is NOT evidence for it; it only closes the enumerated window. No anomaly was observed and none was tuned away.
